########################################
#
# Script contains the comparison of repertoire characteristics between
# matching ONT and PacBio UMI-SPBC groups across downstream filtering
# strategies Base, F1, F2 and F3
#
# Results are shown in LongAIRR Fig. S4
#
########################################

dir_pacbio_bcr <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_pb/airr/ig_p_parse-select.tsv")
dir_pacbio_tcr <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/af5_samples/sp12_pb/airr/tr_p_parse-select.tsv")

filter_min_counts <- c("Base" = 1L, "F1" = 2L, "F2" = 3L, "F3" = 4L)
#filter_min_counts <- c("All reads" = 1L, "Cons. > 1" = 2L, "Cons. > 2" = 3L)

read and prepare AIRR tables
```{r}
first_call <- function(x) {
  str_trim(str_split_fixed(as.character(x), ",", 2)[, 1])
}

gene_without_allele <- function(x) {
  str_remove(first_call(x), "\\*.*$")
}

read_airr <- function(path, platform_name, receptor_group, loci) {
  read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    mutate(
      consensus_count = as.integer(consensus_count),
      v_region_sequence = str_sub(toupper(sequence), start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end)),
      junction_aa = coalesce(na_if(as.character(junction_aa), ""), as.character(alakazam::translateDNA(as.character(junction)))),
      platform = platform_name,
      receptor_group = receptor_group,
      match_id = as.character(group),
      v_gene = gene_without_allele(v_call),
      j_gene = gene_without_allele(j_call),
      junction_nt = toupper(junction),
      junction_aa = toupper(junction_aa),
      c_gene = str_remove(c_call, "\\*.*$")
    ) %>%
    filter(locus %in% loci,
           !is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus,
           !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi),
           !grepl("N", junction_nt),
           !grepl("N", v_region_sequence))
}

airr_comparison <- bind_rows(
  read_airr(dir_ont_bcr, "ONT", "BCR", c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL")),
  read_airr(dir_ont_tcr, "ONT", "TCR", c("TRA", "TRB")),
  read_airr(dir_pacbio_bcr, "PacBio", "BCR", c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL")),
  read_airr(dir_pacbio_tcr, "PacBio", "TCR", c("TRA", "TRB"))
)
```

pair matching ONT and PacBio groups
```{r}
pair_columns <- c(
  "receptor_group", "match_id", "consensus_count", "v_gene", "j_gene",
  "junction_nt", "junction_aa", "c_gene", "v_region_sequence"
)

ont_comparison <- airr_comparison %>%
  filter(platform == "ONT") %>%
  select(all_of(pair_columns))

pacbio_comparison <- airr_comparison %>%
  filter(platform == "PacBio") %>%
  select(all_of(pair_columns))

matched_base <- inner_join(
  ont_comparison,
  pacbio_comparison,
  by = c("receptor_group", "match_id"),
  suffix = c("_ONT", "_PacBio")) %>%
  mutate(
    same_v_gene = v_gene_ONT == v_gene_PacBio,
    same_j_gene = j_gene_ONT == j_gene_PacBio,
    same_junction_aa = junction_aa_ONT == junction_aa_PacBio,
    same_junction_nt = junction_nt_ONT == junction_nt_PacBio,
    same_c_gene = c_gene_ONT == c_gene_PacBio
  )
```

calculate V-region sequence identity
```{r}
pairwise_v_identity <- function(ont_sequence, pacbio_sequence) {
  alignment <- pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(
    Biostrings::DNAString(ont_sequence),
    Biostrings::DNAString(pacbio_sequence),
    type = "global"
  )

  as.numeric(pwalign::pid(alignment, type = "PID1")) / 100
}

matched_base <- matched_base %>%
  mutate(
    v_region_identity = map2_dbl(
      v_region_sequence_ONT,
      v_region_sequence_PacBio,
      pairwise_v_identity
    )
  )
```

apply downstream filtering strategies
```{r}
matched_pairs <- purrr::imap_dfr(filter_min_counts, function(min_count, filter_name) {
  matched_base %>%
    filter(consensus_count_ONT >= min_count,
           consensus_count_PacBio >= min_count) %>%
    mutate(comparison_filter = filter_name)
})
```

prepare heatmap data
```{r}
metric_definitions <- tribble(
  ~metric, ~label, ~plot_order, ~metric_type,
  "same_v_gene", "V gene\n   annotation", 1L, "exact",
  "same_j_gene", "J gene\n   annotation", 2L, "exact",
  "same_junction_aa", "Junction seq.\n      (AA)", 3L, "exact",
  "same_junction_nt", "Junction seq.\n  (nucleotide)", 3L, "exact",
  "same_c_gene", "Constant-region\ngene annotation", 5L, "exact",
  "v_region_identity", "V-region seq.\nidentity (mean)", 4L, "identity"
)

filter_plot_data <- matched_pairs %>%
  select(receptor_group, comparison_filter, match_id, all_of(metric_definitions$metric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(metric_definitions$metric),
    names_to = "metric",
    values_to = "metric_value") %>%
  left_join(metric_definitions, by = "metric") %>%
  group_by(receptor_group, comparison_filter, metric, label, plot_order, metric_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n_evaluable = sum(!is.na(metric_value)),
    n_exact = sum(metric_value == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    agreement = mean(metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    comparison_filter = factor(comparison_filter, levels = names(filter_min_counts)),
    label = factor(label, levels = rev(metric_definitions$label)),
    discordance = 1 - agreement,
    agreement_label = if_else(
      metric_type == "identity",
      paste0("n=", n_evaluable, "\nMean ", percent(agreement, accuracy = 0.1)),
      paste0(n_exact, "/", n_evaluable, "\n", percent(agreement, accuracy = 0.1))),
    label_color = if_else(discordance >= 0.12, "white", "black"))

#flip from disagreement to agreement measure
filter_plot_data <- filter_plot_data %>%
  mutate(agreement_label = if_else(metric_type == "identity",
      paste0("n=", n_evaluable, "\n", percent(agreement, accuracy = 0.01)),
      paste0(n_exact, "/", n_evaluable, "\n", percent(agreement, accuracy = 0.01))),
    label_color = if_else(agreement >= 0.88, "white", "black"))
```

generate heatmap
```{r}
p_matched_filter_agreement <- ggplot(filter_plot_data,
  aes(x = comparison_filter, y = label, fill = agreement)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = agreement_label, color = label_color),
            size = 2.6, lineheight = 0.95) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = agreement_label, color = label_color),
    #         size = 3, lineheight = 0.95) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  facet_wrap(~ receptor_group, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("#F7FBFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#4292C6", "#2171B5", "#08519C", "#08306B"),
  limits = c(0.75, 1), breaks = c(0.75, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95, 1),
  labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), oob = squish, name = "ONT–PacBio\nagreement") +
  labs(x = "Consensus based filtering", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )
```
